poc_summary: run.sh compiles poc.c (open :memory: db, CREATE TABLE t(a,b,c), CREATE INDEX i ON t(a,b,c), SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY a,b,c) against the version's sqlite3.c with -DSQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0 and ASan/UBSan, then runs it — the exact forum reporter's minimal repro.
explanation: Used run_poc (via /poc/run.sh) identically on all three versions. pre_intro (dae87df198a4): exit=0, no sanitizer report. post_intro (cebf06c79801): exit=134, AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow — "READ of size 72" in sqlite3VdbeSorterInit at sqlite3.c:104819 (memcpy overrunning a 76-byte KeyInfo region by exactly the read size), matching the upstream forum ASan report's function name and read size precisely. post_benign: exit=0, no sanitizer report, confirming the shipped fix (matching d4c224b833b7) removes the overflow. The -DSQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0 flag, required per the forum report, is baked into run.sh and applied identically to all three builds, satisfying the same-command invariance requirement. This confirms the labelled OutOfBoundsRead is correctly introduced by the intro commit and correctly fixed by the benign/fix commit.
